movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Firm frame maintained between partners; connection via the leader's left hand and follower's right hand.
movement_profile.footwork: Six-beat pattern: step-step, triple step, triple step. Feet stay light, with heels often lifted.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Back arched with pelvis slightly pushed back.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes acrobatic elements in some competitive styles, though distinct from acrobatic rock 'n' roll.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, compact, with knees flexed and weight on the balls of the feet.

signature_moves.description: A six-beat pattern involving steps and triple steps.
signature_moves.name: Basic Step

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies from soft and languorous (slow) to highly dynamic and precise (fast).

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Syncopated, with emphasis on the second syllable of the triple step.
music_profile.sound_description: The music features a driving, syncopated rhythm often derived from jazz and blues, characterized by a 'ta-da' train-like pulse.

basic_steps: Execute a triple step on beats three and four
Execute a triple step on beats five and six
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with the basic six-beat step; advanced dancers focus on musical interpretation and high-speed footwork.
teaching.rhythm: 6-beat pattern with syncopation on the second syllable of the triple step.
